class.name: SourcePPVTF
class.brief_description: Allows reading and writing Valve Texture Format files through the bundled SourcePP library.

method.name: bake
method.description: Builds the current VTF into a byte array.

method.name: close
method.description: Releases the currently loaded VTF.

method.name: compute_thumbnail
method.description: Regenerates the embedded thumbnail from the current main image data.

method.name: create
method.description: Creates an empty VTF container using the given dimensions and internal VTF [param format].

method.name: create_from_image
method.description: Creates a new VTF from a Godot [Image]. Unsupported or compressed Godot formats are converted to a compatible uncompressed format first.

method.name: get_depth
method.description: Returns the depth of the given mip level.

method.name: get_face_count
method.description: Returns the face count. Cubemaps typically report 6.

method.name: get_frame_count
method.description: Returns the number of animation frames stored in the VTF.

method.name: get_height
method.description: Returns the height of the given mip level.

method.name: get_image
method.description: Decodes one image slice and returns it as a Godot [Image] in [code]Image.FORMAT_RGBA8[/code].

method.name: get_mip_count
method.description: Returns the mip level count.

method.name: get_path
method.description: Returns the last path used to open or save this VTF, or an empty string if it only exists in memory.

method.name: get_thumbnail
method.description: Returns the embedded thumbnail as a Godot [Image] in [code]Image.FORMAT_RGBA8[/code].

method.name: get_width
method.description: Returns the width of the given mip level.

method.name: has_image
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the VTF currently has main image data.

method.name: has_thumbnail_data
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the VTF currently has thumbnail data.

method.name: is_open
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if a VTF is currently loaded.

method.name: open
method.description: Opens the VTF at [param path]. If [member resolver] is assigned, [param path] can also point at a registered VPK entry rather than a loose file. If [param parse_header_only] is [code]true[/code], image payload data may be left unopened until needed.

method.name: open_from_buffer
method.description: Opens a VTF from in-memory bytes.

method.name: remove_thumbnail
method.description: Removes the embedded thumbnail.

method.name: save
method.description: Bakes the current VTF to [param path].

method.name: set_format
method.description: Changes the VTF image format using the encoder default quality.

method.name: set_format_with_quality
method.description: Changes the VTF image format and forwards an explicit encoder quality value when supported.

method.name: set_image
method.description: Replaces one image slice using the provided Godot [Image].

method.name: set_thumbnail
method.description: Replaces the embedded thumbnail from a Godot [Image].

members.member: Optional resolver used to load VTF files directly from registered Source game VPKs.
Optional registered game ID used when querying [member resolver]. If empty, the resolver iterates over registered games in registration order for each requested entry.
The internal [code]ImageFormat[/code] used by the VTF payload.
Whether the VTF is marked as sRGB.
The VTF version field used for baking.
